purpose: Validate SCB-derived persons-per-dwelling defaults used by housing scenario auto mode.
requiredChecks: all five municipalities have a local or Sweden fallback for every supported auto combination
all auto defaults are finite and strictly positive
occupancyDefaultYear matches the configured production year
sources identify the SCB household tables
municipality-specific rows take precedence over Sweden fallback
unsupported combinations do not silently retain a stale automatic value; manual input is required instead
governance: Persons per dwelling is a scenario default derived from observed persons per household, not a dwelling-capacity maximum.
Sweden fallback is permitted only when the exact municipal cell is unavailable.
Unsupported dwelling/tenure combinations must be explicit manual assumptions rather than hidden imputation.
